deadline.value: Priority consideration is February 15; the final deadline is April 15.

gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) score is optional

gre_subject.value: The GRE subject test is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE subject test is not required

toefl_min.value: Internet TOEFL 100 is the PhD minimum, with a Speaking score of 18.
toefl_min.quote: Internet test: 79 (100 for PhD), with a minimum Speaking Score of 18

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.5 with no sub-score below 6.0 is the PhD minimum.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: 6.5 (7.5 for PhD with no sub-score below 6.0)

english_waiver.value: The TOEFL is waived only for approved English-speaking countries; India is not on the Graduate College list.
english_waiver.quote: The TOEFL is waived for approved English speaking countries

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's degree in biological, computational or other disciplines.
entry_route.quote: Applicants to any Bioinformatics Data Science program must hold a bachelor’s degree in biological, computational, or other disciplines

supervisor.value: The department pages do not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department pages do not say how PhD students are funded.

notes: Bioinformatics Data Science PhD, a data science track. The department page says the TOEFL is waived for approved English-speaking countries. Conditional admission exists for applicants who need more English training.
name: Bioinformatics Data Science (PhD)
